Argument.Label: What is the &date you want to format?
Argument.Description: A variable holding the date to convert.

Argument.Label: What is the &old format of the date?
Argument.Description: The format of the date variable in its current form, e.g. "mmddyy".

Argument.Label: What is the &new format you want the date to have?
Argument.Description: The format to convert to, e.g. "yyyy-mm-dd".
